meta.title: Mobilcab — from idea to cut list, straight from your browser
meta.description: Cloud-based furniture CAD that runs in your browser, on a laptop. Now: 3D design and cut lists. Nesting and CNC come later, by stage.

hero.title: From idea to cut list, straight from your browser.
hero.body: Mobilcab is a cloud-based CAD for furniture — works in the browser, on a laptop. No installs, no license servers. Now: 3D design and cut lists. Sheet nesting and CNC export come later, as we ship each stage.

problem.title: Sound familiar?
items: Heavy CAD software installed on one single workshop computer
Expensive licenses for features you barely use
Hours lost manually building the cut list for cutting
No easy way to show a live design to a client without bringing them to the workshop PC

items.title: 100% browser-based
items.body: No install, no license server. Open the browser on your laptop and get to work.

items.title: For furniture makers
items.body: Built for the workshop: clear language and a design flow for made-to-order furniture — not a general CAD awkwardly forced into cabinets.

items.title: Start free
items.body: Use the app free on Cut list. If you want 20% off paid plans when billing opens, join the Founding Partner waitlist — enrollment closes at billing.

items.title: Workshop-ready cut list
items.body: From the design you get the cut list: parts, sizes, quantities and materials — what you need to cut, without manual calculations.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.offerDetail: You join the program for free. When we move to paid plans, you get 20% off full price for 6 months from first payment. Anyone who joins later pays full price.
pricing.aiNote: At billing: Free (3 exports) + paid Cut list. Then Atelier, CNC, Production, AI.
pricing.free: The app is free until we open payment.
pricing.cancel: Joining does not oblige you to pay.

items.q: Do I need to install anything?
items.a: No, Mobilcab runs straight from your browser.

items.q: Does it work on tablet or phone?
items.a: Not yet — it's built for laptop. Tablet and phone come later.

items.q: Can I export directly for my CNC?
items.a: The cut list is the foundation; CNC export comes in a later roadmap stage.
Now: Free = Cut list, no export limit. Founding Partner: 20% / 6 months on paid plans (waitlist closes at billing). At billing: Free with 3 exports + paid Cut list; then Atelier, CNC, Production, AI.
